_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil statistics (3% break rate) and broken capital formation override the historical analog; HOLD wins if the score stays in the 24-31 band while waiting for ETF flows or VIX to confirm direction.
next_move.brains_agree: No — Analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing coil statistics and broken capital formation; Narrative implies accumulation/bottom favoring patience but does not explicitly call direction, creating a split on whether the analog or live divergences should drive positioning.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive (>20) and stablecoin growth recovers above 50 with BTC holding $62K — validates Disbelief transition attempt (up-leg)
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $60K with VIX spiking above 22 and funding flipping negative — pushes to Capitulation (down-leg)
